title: A sign of gathering
summary: Jesus gives a sign concerning the gathering of Israel and the making known of his words to the Gentiles.

explicit_facts.text: Jesus gives a sign concerning when Israel will be gathered from its dispersion and Zion established among them.
The sign involves Jesus's words being made known to the Gentiles, concerning the remnant of Jacob and Jesus's people scattered by them.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Jesus speaks to an audience; the audience is not specified in these verses.
unspecified_visual_details: The audience's appearance, size, and arrangement.
Any visual depiction of the future gathering or Zion.

spoken_dialogue.speaker: Jesus Christ (at Bountiful)

narration.text: my people, O house of Israel,

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The gathering and establishment of Zion are future events, not present action in the scene.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict a present-day gathering, Zion, or the future remnant as if these events are occurring now.

title: Words come forth to the remnant
summary: Jesus says the Father's words will come from the Gentiles to the people, so a remnant of the seed may receive them and the covenant be fulfilled.

explicit_facts.text: Jesus says these things will be made known to the Gentiles by the Father and come forth from them to the people.
The Father intends the Gentiles to be established in the land as a free people, so these things may come forth to a remnant of the people's seed and the covenant be fulfilled.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Jesus continues speaking to an audience.
unspecified_visual_details: The land, Gentiles, and remnant are not given a present-day visual setting in this passage.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The establishment and transmission described are future or explanatory, not a narrated event happening in the scene.
prohibited_inventions: Do not portray specific historical Gentiles, a migration, or a particular settlement not described here.

title: A sign to the seed
summary: Jesus explains that the works coming from the Gentiles will be a sign when the seed begins to know them; he says Gentiles may repent, be baptized, and be numbered among Israel.

explicit_facts.text: Works will come forth from the Gentiles to the seed, which dwindles in unbelief because of iniquity.
The Father brings the works forth from the Gentiles to show his power; Gentiles who do not harden their hearts may repent, be baptized in Jesus's name, and be numbered among his people.
When the seed begins to know these things, it will be a sign that the Father's work has commenced toward fulfilling his covenant with Israel.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Jesus continues speaking to an audience.
unspecified_visual_details: The works, their means of transmission, and the future recipients' appearance.

title: Kings consider what they see

explicit_facts.text: Jesus says kings will shut their mouths and see and consider what they had not been told or heard.
The Father will work a great and marvelous work, and some will not believe it although a man declares it to them.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Jesus continues speaking to an audience.
unspecified_visual_details: The kings, the man, and the work have no described appearance or identified setting.

title: The servant will be healed
summary: Jesus says his servant will be protected from being hurt, though marred, and healed; those who refuse Jesus's words will be cut off from the covenant people.

explicit_facts.text: Jesus says his servant's life is in his hand; others will not hurt him, though he will be marred, and Jesus will heal him.
Jesus says those who do not believe his words, which the Father will cause his servant to bring forth to the Gentiles, will be cut off from the covenant people.

title: The remnant among the Gentiles
summary: Jesus uses lion imagery to describe the remnant of Jacob among the Gentiles and says their hand will be lifted against adversaries.

explicit_facts.text: Jesus says the remnant of Jacob will be among the Gentiles, comparing them to a lion among forest beasts and a young lion among sheep.
Jesus says the remnant's hand will be lifted upon adversaries and their enemies cut off.

explicit_facts.text: If they repent, hearken, and do not harden their hearts, Jesus will establish his church among them and they will be numbered among the remnant of Jacob.
They will assist Jesus's people and others of Israel who come to build a city called the New Jerusalem.
